items.title: Robust Performance
items.description: Unleash your creativity with seamless multitasking, AI-accelerated workflows, and stunning visuals. Yoga laptops boast the latest Intel® Core™ Ultra processors for advanced performance.

items.title: Vivid Display
items.description: Enjoy vibrant, true-to-life color, glowing highlights, and sharp detail in every task on up to a PureSight Pro OLED display. Whether you’re editing or rendering, this up to tandem OLED display is built to last and keeps every project looking bold, clear, and brilliant.

items.title: Responsive Keyboard
items.description: Experience a keyboard that stays clean and premium, even during long sessions, thanks to its oil- and water-resistant Yoga coating. Enjoy precise, responsive, and satisfying typing with 1.5mm key travel. Designed for comfort and productivity, it empowers you to type, edit, and create with confidence.

items.title: All-Day Battery
items.description: Stay creative and productive all day thanks to Yoga devices’ long battery life. Work, create, and stay connected longer without constantly searching for an outlet.

items.title: Unmatched Productivity
items.description: Stay sharp and sound your best on every call. Yoga’s webcam delivers crisp clarity, while four mics with 360° reception and Voice ID capture your voice with precision. Up to six immersive speakers make every conversation easier to follow, so you spend less time repeating yourself and more time getting things done.

items.title: All-Metal Chassis
items.description: Yoga’s all-metal chassis, crafted from magnesium-aluminum or aluminum alloy, offers the perfect balance of lightweight design and durability. This advanced material ensures laptops are lighter for enhanced portability, while maintaining exceptional strength to withstand daily wear and tear.

items.title: Jon Rettinger
items.description: “The Yoga Slim 7x isn't just an alternative in ways that matter day-to-day. It's actually better. Lighter, brighter screen with actual black instead of gray, double the refresh rate, more keyboard travel, touchscreen if you want it. Same performance unplugged.”

items.title: Dave2D
items.description: “The new Lenovo Slim 7X, it's an awesome device this year. Super fast chip, crazy battery life.”

items.title: The Tech Chap
items.description: “And this is actually quite a nice upgrade. We've got the brand new Ryzen AI 400 series chips. We have faster memory, better cooling. We have a refined keyboard. It's a touch lighter. It's just 13.9 mm thick. We also have one of the absolute best displays on any laptop that I've tested.”

items.title: Hardware Canucks

items.title: Zip Tie Tech
items.description: “The display is freaking amazing. No matter what program you launch, it's displayed accurately, and you don't have to go in and be like, 'Oh, Chrome is sRGB, and then Photoshop is Adobe RGB.' Nope, you just don't worry about it. It figures it out for you and looks magical while it does it.”
